items.title: Print milestone_status table after milestone-aware mutating commands
items.context: Add a mechanical post-command output path so commands like checklist_update, verification_evidence_batch_add, verification_evidence_refresh_stale, story_advance, delivery_check_save, summary_set, and milestone_ledger_set/add append the same human table as `lattice milestone_status --storyId=<id>` when the story has a milestone ledger.

items.title: Cover stdout contract with regression tests
items.context: Add focused tests proving a representative state-change command emits `Milestone Status - B-xxxx`, `Completed`, `Current`, and `Remaining` in stdout instead of silently consuming milestone_status.
